similar_bugs.title: Historical Bug
similar_bugs.description: Created by Kazushi Marukawa jam pobox com on Friday July 31 1998 3 25 14 PM PDT Additional Details Netscape and Mozilla hasn t work correctly with a http user passwd hostname path style URI after the Netscape 4 05 I m not sure whether this URI is right or not But few months ago we can use it Is it a BUG or right behavior This I believe is a duplicate of non bugzilla bug Reassiging to Judson who had fixed that The actual format is http username password server com Marking Verified Invalid

similar_bugs.title: Historical Bug
similar_bugs.description: If you attempt to file a bug using bugzilla in NGlayout I am first asked for my email address and password to log in I enter valid data that works fine in Nav4 but apparently we re not sending the same string as Nav4 because bugzilla refuses my login in NGLayout but accepts it in Nav4 I suspect the fact that the login form uses GET rather than POST may be part of the issue but what do I know Bug 1168 has been marked as a duplicate of this bug http cvs mirror mozilla org webtools bugzilla enter_b

similar_bugs.title: Historical Bug
similar_bugs.description: This page asks for an email address and password which I supply I click Login and it seems to accept the values but then returns the same page with the form fields emptied I can t log in I think this bug is relatively high priority because we want our testers to use Viewer as their everyday browser and they ll need this This bug has been marked as a duplicate of 866
